name: Passed
descr: Sent and acknowledged, the expected message (if any) arrived and its checks held

name: Failed
descr: Not acknowledged (rejected, timeout), or the expected message did not arrive or a check failed

name: Error
descr: Could not be sent (connection, unknown variable, invalid payload)

name: Not Sent
descr: The run was stopped, or an earlier message failed (stop at first failure)

name: Pending
descr: Not sent yet - the run is still in progress
